article.title: Mayor Brandon Johnson's Re-Election Campaign and Community Organizing in Chicago
article.author: bareditors
article.content: Mayor Brandon Johnson's Re-Election Campaign and Community Organizing in Chicago Authors Black Agenda Radio with Margaret Kimberley bareditors Thu, 11/26/2026 - 06:22 February 27 is election day in Chicago. Frank Chapman, Executive Director of the National Alliance Against Racist and Political Repression , provides analysis on the NAARPR's role in organizing elected community councils to oversee public safety as the donor class designates a candidate to run against Mayor Brandon Johnson.
